Witch's apothecary corner — foreground brass scale tilted under amber candlelight, mortar dusted with dried chamomile; mid-shelf rows of hand-labeled cork-stopped jars dense as a library wall; deeper shelves receding into shadow hold bundled mugwort and tallow-dipped rosemary swags; back wall hung with drying lavender and iron hooks; dust-motes drifting in warm lampglow across a scarred dark-oak apothecary bench.

Candlelit gothic library — oil-lamp pools amber over an ornate mahogany writing-desk cluttered with open ledgers and a wax-sealed inkwell; mid-frame towering dark-oak bookcases press leather-bound spines shoulder to shoulder; a rolling brass ladder rests against the shelves; deeper cases recede toward a back wall hung with a faded heraldic tapestry; uppermost shelves vanish into warm shadow, dust-motes drifting between candle flames.

Scrying-chamber alcove — foreground velvet-draped table holds a fogged crystal orb ringed by dripping taper candles; scattered tarot cards curl at table-edge; mid-ground a brass astrolabe and pendulum rest on a small carved side-table; deeper shelves carry bundled correspondence and a worn celestial atlas; back wall draped in midnight-plum velvet absorbs the candlelight into soft amber shadow, the air thick and still.

Alchemy laboratory shelf — close frame on a stone-slab workbench where a copper alembic crouches beside coiled glass tubing catching oil-lamp warmth; mid-ground a cluttered rack holds brass retorts and clay crucibles; deeper shelves are stacked with leather alchemy tomes, spines cracked and gilt-faded; hanging brass instruments sway above; back wall is soot-dark stone, a single iron bracket lamp bleeding amber into the layered dimness.

Curio-cabinet wonder-room — foreground glass case lit by a single oil-lamp holds a small articulated fox skull beside a nautilus shell; mid-ground shelves display taxidermied beetles under bell-jars and polished jet geodes; deeper cabinets recede with coral specimens and amber-trapped insects; back wall carries mounted butterfly frames and a large convex mirror reflecting the amber lamp; the room hums with quiet density and warm shadow.

Rain-window reading nook — a deep-set arched window alcove, leaded panes rain-streaked and amber-candlelit from within; foreground is a tufted velvet window-seat cushion in forest-green pressed against the cold stone sill; mid-ground a chaotic stack of cloth-bound volumes leans against the inner wall; a single brass chamberstick candle on the sill throws gold light across a half-open book; deeper the room recedes into warm bookshelved dimness, amber and still.

Fireplace alcove — a broad stone fireplace dominates the frame, hearth crackling amber; foreground mantle-shelf crowds a brass clock, a cluster of mismatched candlesticks, and a dried-flower arrangement in a black ceramic jar; mid-ground a high-backed gothic armchair in worn oxblood leather faces the fire; adjacent shelves carry fire-warmed rows of cloth-bound books; back wall is rough stone, soot-darkened, the whole space soaked in breathing firelight, warm and deeply still.

Gothic bedroom corner — a carved four-poster bed dominates the frame, draping wine-velvet curtains pooling at the floor; foreground shows a Persian rug in dark ruby and indigo; mid-ground antique nightstand in dark walnut holds a brass three-arm candelabra dripping wax over a half-read leather volume; deeper the bed-curtains part on layered bedding in ivory and charcoal; back wall carries a framed botanical print of nightshade and a small wall-mounted sconce, amber and hushed.

Scrying-divination chamber — foreground velvet table-cloth in deep teal pools over a round table; a smoked crystal orb in a carved-bone stand centers the surface; scattered tarot cards with worn gilt edges fan around it; mid-ground a brass orrery with verdigris arms sits on a side-shelf; deeper a floor-to-ceiling dark curtain hides the back wall; candles in iron holders ring the table, flame-tips bending in an unfelt draft, their wax already deeply pooled.

Scrying chamber alcove — a round velvet-draped table in midnight blue holds a faceted crystal ball at center, scattered tarot cards fanned at its base; three beeswax candles form a triangle around the cloth; a brass astrolabe rests at the table edge; behind, a shelf of pendulums, obsidian mirrors, and rolled parchment scrolls; the back wall breathes warm amber candlelight through layered shadow.

Witch's apothecary corner, warm amber candlelight pooling across a scarred oak bench crowded with brass scales and a marble mortar-and-pestle in the foreground; mid-tier shelves dense with hand-labeled brown glass jars of dried petals, powdered bark, and preserved seeds; higher shelves receding into shadow hold bundles of hanging lavender, rosemary, and mugwort tied with black ribbon; the back wall bristles with copper hooks bearing dried bat-wing ferns and waxed paper parcels; dust-motes drift lazily through the candle warmth above.

Candlelit gothic library alcove, a deep-carved oak writing-desk dominating the foreground, its surface crowded with a brass oil-lamp, an open leather-bound grimoire, and scattered wax-sealed envelopes; behind it a towering bookcase with finial-carved uprights fills the midground, spines worn to velvet softness; a rolling ladder on a brass rail leans mid-shelf; the back wall is almost lost in warm shadow, hung with a faded botanical engraving in a tarnished gilt frame; above, cobwebs trace cathedral arches between shelves.

Scrying chamber alcove, a round velvet-draped table commands the foreground with a cloudy crystal ball at its center, tarot cards fanned in a slow arc, and three beeswax candles in iron holders dripping soft amber light; the midground holds a carved side-table bearing a brass astrolabe and pendulum on a hook; a deep-purple velvet curtain closes the back wall almost entirely, a single candelabra bracket mounted against it; dust-motes swirl in the candle convection above the crystal.

Alchemy laboratory shelf-cluster, a stone slab bench in the foreground carries a copper alembic with a thin curl of aromatic steam, glass distillation flasks linked by cork tubing, and a ceramic crucible ringed by tallow candles; midground oak shelves hold rows of leather-spined alchemy tomes, a hanging brass balance, and a rack of small iron retort stands; the back wall bears a framed zodiac diagram and bundled copper tubing on wooden pegs; warm oil-lamp light tints every surface honey-gold.

Curio-cabinet wonder-room corner, a massive walnut display case occupies the midground, its glass panes amber-hazed by a single hanging oil-lamp; foreground shelf-edge displays a taxidermied raven perched on a brass stand beside two ammonite fossils and a cluster of deep-purple amethyst geodes; inside the case, stacked drawers overflow with pinned beetles, a small horned skull, pressed fern fronds, and coiled shed snakeskin in bell-jars; the back wall holds framed engravings of anatomical curiosities in dense rows.

Rain-window reading nook, a deep arched embrasure fitted with a tufted velvet cushion in midnight-green cradles a teetering stack of cloth-bound books in the foreground; a single beeswax candle in a pewter holder casts a small warm halo; stained-glass panes streaked with running rain glow faintly amber-rose in the midground; a narrow side-shelf cut into the stone holds a dried-flower posy and a ribbon-marked journal; the outer stone sill is furred with soft candlewax drips and lichen tracery.

Fireplace alcove, a wide stone hearth with a low crackling fire dominates the midground, its warm orange glow spilling onto a worn Persian rug in the foreground; a carved gothic armchair upholstered in burgundy velvet sits angled toward the heat; the mantle above carries a brass candelabra, two beeswax pillars, a small bronze owl figurine, and a stack of slim leather-bound volumes; flanking shelves recede into warm amber shadow, their spines furred with time; a raven roosts quietly on the chair-back.

Witch's apothecary corner, the foreground bench surface crowded with a brass apothecary scale mid-measurement, a pestle resting in a worn stone mortar filled with crushed violet petals, and three stoppered bottles of dark tincture; mid-tier shelves hold dozens of cork-sealed glass jars with handwritten parchment labels curling at the corners; upper shelves recede into candlelit shadow bearing crockery herb-crocks and coils of dried orange peel; the back wall is a solid curtain of hanging herb bundles and drying rose-hips tied with twine.

Candlelit gothic library, a wing-back velvet armchair in deep teal occupies the foreground, its armrests flanked by a low carved side-table holding an oil-lamp and a dog-eared leatherbound tome; behind it a floor-to-ceiling oak bookcase with gothic-arch tracery at its crown fills the midground, shelves double-stacked with worn spines; a brass library ladder leans at an angle; deep into the background the wall is barely visible beneath framed maps and a mounted antler rack draped with dried botanicals; dust softens every edge.

Scrying and divination chamber, a hexagonal room corner draped entirely in layered midnight-blue and black velvet curtains forming the back wall; in the foreground a low carved table bears a pendulum suspended from a tripod stand, scattered tarot cards face-down on dark silk, and two stubby tallow candles in ornate silver holders; mid-depth a brass astrolabe rests open on a velvet cushion beside a crystal sphere on a claw-footed stand; warm candle convection lifts the velvet hem gently, dust-motes circling in the amber air.

Alchemy laboratory corner, a cluttered stone-topped workbench in the foreground holds a copper alembic connected by glass tubing to a condensing flask, a small oil-lamp burner beneath, and a brass mortar scattered with sulfur-yellow powder; midground open shelves carry leather alchemy tomes with gilt-stamped spines, a rack of corked vials in amber and green glass, and a hanging brass sextant; the back wall is papered in faded alchemical diagrams pinned with brass tacks; a slow spiral of steam climbs toward the low vaulted ceiling.

Gothic bedroom corner, a four-poster bed with carved ebony posts and deep-crimson velvet curtains half-drawn fills the midground; the foreground shows a small antique nightstand bearing a silver candelabra with three lit tapers, a ribbon-marked leather book laid open, and a porcelain dish of dried rose petals; a Persian rug in burgundy and gold covers the stone floor; beyond the bed-curtain the back wall holds a gilt-framed oval mirror reflecting only warm candlelight; wax drips trace slow rivulets down the candelabra arms.

Witch's apothecary corner, a dense foreground shelf-edge displaying a row of twelve cork-and-wax-sealed bottles in graduating amber tones, a coil of dried mugwort, and a small cast-iron cauldron with a ladle; midground shelves behind bear stacked crockery labeled in faded ink — belladonna, wormwood, yarrow, elder — arranged by height; higher still, bundles of dried herbs in black-ribbon clusters hang from iron hooks; the back wall is paneled dark oak with an engraved wooden panel of a botanical wheel; a tallow candle burns low on the bench corner.

Curio-cabinet wonder-room, a floor-to-ceiling built-in display case of mahogany and glass fills the midground wall, its compartments individually lit by the warm spill of a single oil-lamp on a central shelf; in the foreground on a marble-topped table, a taxidermied white ermine beside an open velvet-lined specimen tray of iridescent beetles; cabinet shelves hold a small human skull with a candle socketed in the crown, preserved sea-creatures in bell-jars of yellowed fluid, a cluster of peacock feathers, and rows of labeled mineral specimens; the room breathes amber.

Candlelit gothic library, a massive carved-oak writing-desk dominates the foreground, its surface dense with an open cartography folio, a brass inkwell, quill, a dripping taper in a pewter dish, and a magnifying lens on a jointed brass arm; midground floor-to-ceiling bookcases with carved-finial tops display leather-bound rows double-deep; a brass rolling ladder is frozen mid-rail; the back wall between the cases holds a faded tapestry map; the oil-lamp on the desk casts everything in layered warm gold and deep shadow; dust-motes settle on open pages.

Alchemy laboratory shelf, a recessed stone alcove in the foreground holds a copper retort over a low spirit-lamp, its neck curving into a glass receiver flask; mid-tier shelves carry a row of wax-sealed earthenware crocks labeled in faded Latin, a hanging brass plumb-bob, and a small hand-bellows; behind, deeper shelves hold folded leather-bound folios, a ceramic skull used as a paperweight, and a glass jar of preserved salamanders; the back wall bears an enormous hand-drawn zodiac-alchemical diagram in faded sepia, candlelight warming its margins.

Scrying chamber alcove, a bay formed by two velvet curtains in deep wine-red encloses a round table spread with black silk in the foreground; on it a large crystal orb on a carved obsidian stand, three beeswax candles at the table's three visible points, and a scatter of rune-carved tiles; midground a carved wooden shelf-unit holds a brass astrolabe, a pendulum clock with a still pendulum, and a stack of handwritten vellum pages; the back curtain is pinned with a single pressed black rose; warm candle-smoke hazes the air above.

Gothic bedroom corner, a carved ebony dressing-table in the foreground bears a tarnished silver mirror, a candelabra with five tapers, a glass perfume bottle shaped like a bat, and an open jewel-casket spilling jet beads; midground shelves built into the wall above hold cloth-bound poetry collections, a small oil-lamp, and a ceramic owl; the four-poster bed's velvet canopy is just visible at the midground edge, its curtain warmly backlit by a hearth beyond the frame; Persian rug fringe fills the foreground floor, candlelight amber on every surface.

Witch's apothecary corner, morning-dark even at noon — the small mullioned window is shuttered — tallow candles on a tiered iron stand provide all light, warm and flickering; the foreground bench holds a large marble mortar and pestle mid-grind, a worn leather recipe-journal open with botanical sketches, and a row of dark-glass dropper bottles; mid-tier shelves carry labeled clay pots of dried roots, bundled black-tipped feathers, and a brass funnel; high shelves near the low ceiling are almost invisible, packed with hanging bundles whose shadows move in the candle-stir.

Candlelit gothic library reading-chair cluster, a deep wing-back chair in forest-green velvet sits in the foreground, a low ottoman before it stacked with open quartos; to one side a carved side-table bears an oil-lamp with a green glass shade, a half-drunk cup of something dark, and a slim leather-bound volume; the midground bookcase runs floor to ceiling in dark oak with gothic-arch fretwork at the top, spines worn warm colors; behind the case a second tier of shelves is glimpsed; a raven on the chair-back tips its head; amber dust hangs in the air.
